host_threads.policy: Pin OMP/MKL to six allocated CPUs for this repeated timing run.
host_threads.comparison_scope: Keep prior unpinned 1k smoke diagnostic; use consistently pinned threads for repeated cost curves.
host_threads.causal_claim: This operational pin is not established as a fix for previous startup slowness.

stability.summary: R-KV repeats are tightly grouped; StreamingLLM first-use spread and AgentKV 80 percent variation remain. All three points contribute to medians/ranges; no confidence interval is inferred.

semantics.ordinary_tps: Synchronized native loop rates include eviction/output processing; scheduling/reset/verification outside the loop remain excluded.
semantics.selection_compaction: Whole instrumented prefix-plus-continuation replay totals, nested in inference; not per-token rates or costs to add again.
semantics.warmup: Unchanged source312 standard synthetic warmup; no additional per-shape warmup. First repetition is not guaranteed cold because preceding work and persistent caches can prime execution.
semantics.memory: Prefill occupancy uses 8192 logical cached tokens; decode occupancy uses 8256. Prefill and ordinary-decode peaks have explicit separate boundaries; reserved pool and total VRAM are distinct.
semantics.comparability: This 64-decode/three-repeat version is separate from 8-decode feasibility and old unpinned 1k smoke.

interpretation: All 30 cells and 90 passes completed under the original cap and time bounds. All ordinary/instrumented pairs match outputs and retention events.
R-KV decode medians at 80/50/25 percent are approximately 5.093/5.143/10.372 tokens per second, with at most 0.40 percent maximum-to-minimum spread across repetitions.

StreamingLLM first-use differences persist; its later 50 percent repetitions differ by about 3.64 percent. AgentKV 80 percent spans about 5.75 percent. These ranges remain visible and are not removed as outliers.
The 8k maximum total peak of 29.747 GiB is lower than the 4k maximum of 36.812 GiB. Allocator reservation and active tensor peaks are distinct, and memory curves are not forced to be monotone.
The predeclared 50 percent cross-method view retains all first repetitions and is accompanied by complete all-retention supplements, including ordinary-decode memory peaks.
These measurements cover one fixed history and technical repetitions. They do not establish task success, model accuracy, recovery quality or task-bootstrap uncertainty.

allocator_reservation_observation.per_pass_reset: Pinned native.start empties allocator cache and resets peak counters on each pass; the high reservation is not simply leftover cache from the preceding method.
allocator_reservation_observation.interpretation: 8k R-KV 80 percent total peak is 28.640 GiB versus 36.812 GiB at 4k; R-KV 50 percent reaches 29.747 GiB. Reservation is non-monotone with history length under this pinned runtime. Preserve all measured points without fitting or attributing a particular allocator cause.

paired_figures.decode_peak_boundary: Whole ordinary prefix-plus-continuation decode pass; includes allocator reservation, not KV occupancy.

variation_audit.scope: Saved component and ordinary/replay timing comparison only; no rerun, outlier removal or causal attribution.
